shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: A soft plunge is what you want here. Too gentle and the ball rolls back to the plunger, too hard and it ends up in the pop bumpers.

shots.name: Souvenirs Target
shots.notes: Spring loaded, so it kicks the ball back hard. Three purple lights run 1, 2, Extra Ball — and each one only stays lit briefly, so the three hits have to come quickly.

shots.name: The Pipeline
shots.notes: A saucer that returns the ball to the left inlane through a metal pipe. Carries the Lock light for multiball and the Adv. Double light for D-O-U-B-L-E letters.

shots.name: The Rapids
shots.notes: Runs around the back of the playfield to the right inlane. This is where jackpots, super jackpots, the Special and Go For The Record all live.

shots.name: Three Million Target
shots.notes: A small target beside the Rapids entrance. Dead most of the game and worth 3M a hit during its own nine-second round.

shots.name: The Boomerang
shots.notes: A spinner lane that plays like a left orbit, returning the ball to the right of the Splash targets. Worth 50K a spin all game long, and around 250K a spin during its round.

shots.name: The Splash
shots.notes: Three drop targets dead centre with Rodney sitting on top of them. Clearing all three is worth 500K at any point in the game and advances the Splash column.

shots.name: The Whirlpool
shots.notes: A spiral cup right behind the Splash targets that counts your swirls on the way down and drops the ball out to the pop bumpers.

shots.name: Whirlpool Ramp
shots.notes: The feed to the Whirlpool, marked with the monkey and the Adv. Arcade light. Its bridge carries the 50K, 100K, 200K and Million lights.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Three of them behind the Splash targets. Where a too-hard plunge ends up, and where the Whirlpool empties out.

shots.name: The Plunge
shots.notes: The mystery award saucer, and the target of the skill shot. Multiball and timed rounds are the only things that switch it off; the rest of the game it is sitting there lit. Once it pays out, the ball comes back down the Rapids and out at the right inlane.

shots.name: Boomerang Return Lane
shots.notes: Where the Boomerang spits the ball back out. You cannot shoot it directly from the flippers — it only happens on rebounds.

shots.name: Snack Attack Targets
shots.notes: Three drops on the right side facing left, with 5K, 50K and 500K marked in front of them. They do not feed the bonus grid, so they are incidental scoring rather than something to aim at.

shots.name: Arcade Target
shots.notes: Spring loaded like the Souvenirs target, in the bottom right. Its three lights run 100K, 200K, 300K, but the value can be built far past that.

shots.name: Bonus Grid
shots.notes: Five columns by five rows of lights just above the flippers. Columns start rounds, rows hand out awards, and the Special, Extra Special and Double Everything lights sit underneath.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: One of the two Advance Random Slide rollovers. When lit, rolling it advances a grid column for free.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: The other Advance Random Slide rollover, and where both the Rapids and the Plunge return the ball.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: One of the two Exit award rollovers. Also the side a death save can be pulled from, off the pin by the trough entrance.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: The other Exit award. With the bottom grid row lit, a drain here pays anything from 5K to 5M instead of nothing.

shots.name: Slingshots
shots.notes: On later grids only one inlane rollover is lit, and slingshot hits are what swap which one it is.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Whirlpool ramp, the Snack Attack drops and the Arcade target.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds the Pipeline, the Rapids and the Boomerang.

goals.title: The Soft Plunge
goals.summary: Plunge gently on your first attempt and drop the ball straight into the Plunge saucer for a random award. Get it wrong in either direction and the game tells you so — and if you plunge too softly first and then make it, you are awarded precisely nothing.

steps.action: Gentle plunge into the Plunge saucer
steps.detail: Too soft and the ball rolls back to you, too hard and it disappears into the pop bumpers. It has to be your first attempt to count — a retry pays nothing.

goals.title: The Too-Hard Plunge
goals.summary: Overcook the plunge and the ball lands in the pop bumpers — but the Exit lights start flashing for about ten seconds, and a flashing Exit award is always an extra ball. A bad plunge is briefly one of the best things that can happen to you.
goals.reward: Extra ball from an outlane drain

steps.detail: The game will tell you that you shot too hard.

steps.action: Take an outlane while they flash
steps.detail: The window is roughly ten seconds and the flashing Exit award is always an extra ball.

goals.title: The Bonus Grid
goals.summary: Everything on this machine feeds one five-by-five grid of lights above the flippers. Five shots each own a column, columns start rounds and rows hand out awards. Reading the grid is the whole game — Rodney even tells you when a column is one light from finishing.
goals.reward: Rounds, awards and 5M per completed grid

steps.detail: Pipeline, Rapids, Boomerang, all three Splash drops, and the Whirlpool each advance their own column.

steps.action: Take free advances at the inlanes
steps.detail: A lit Advance Random Slide rollover advances a column for nothing; the light then goes out until another playfield target is hit so you cannot farm it by rocking the ball.
On the first grid both rollovers are lit. After that only one is, and slingshot hits swap it — as does rolling the lit one.
Multiball and every timed round except Double lock the columns — no advances at all — and once the top row is the only one left, the rollover lights go out.

goals.title: The Five Row Awards
goals.summary: Completing a row across the grid turns on a feature rather than paying points, and each row does something different. Knowing which row you are close to is how you decide what to shoot next.
goals.reward: Exit awards, Arcade value, the lock, extra ball, Super Score
instructions: Bottom row lights the Exit awards on both outlanes — a random 5K to 5M for a drain, which stays lit as long as that row is lit or until the ball ends.
Second row lights the Arcade target for 100K, climbing 100K per hit to a 600K ceiling.
Third row lights the Lock at the Pipeline for multiball. It stays lit until you collect it or lose the ball.
Fourth row lights the Souvenirs target for an extra ball, but it takes three hits to walk the purple lights up to it and each light only stays on briefly.
Top row is Super Score, which puts 1M on the Arcade target and adds another million with every hit; the target stays lit for the rest of the ball.
Finish a whole grid and your end-of-ball bonus picks up 5M, with every lit light on the grid paying 10K besides.

goals.title: Three Million Round
goals.summary: The reward for completing the Pipeline column. The Three Million target lights for nine seconds and pays exactly what its name says on every hit. It is a short window on a small target, so have the ball under control before you finish that column.

steps.detail: The round starts as soon as the column fills.
Nine seconds, 3M a hit, and nothing else on the playfield can be advanced while it runs.

goals.title: Boomerang Round
goals.summary: Complete the Boomerang column and the spinner jumps from its usual 50K a spin to around 250K for nine seconds. One clean, hard shot up that lane is worth more than most of the playfield combined during those nine seconds.
goals.reward: About 250K per spin for nine seconds

steps.detail: Every trip up the lane advances it as well as scoring.
The award is per spin, so a full-speed shot that rattles the spinner is worth several soft ones.

goals.title: Safari
goals.summary: The Splash column starts the best round in the game. Four animals light for nineteen seconds — the Rapids toucan, the Boomerang elephant, the Whirlpool monkey and the Arcade lion. Take them in any order for 1M, 2M, 3M, and then a Special.

steps.detail: All three drops down advances it, and it is worth 500K every time regardless.
Rapids and Whirlpool are the two you can take from a controlled ball.
Order does not matter — the values climb as you collect, not in a fixed sequence.

steps.action: Finish on the lion for the Special
steps.detail: Nineteen seconds is generous for four shots, but only if you do not waste the first five.

goals.title: Extra Ball Round
goals.summary: Completing the Whirlpool column lights two randomly chosen slides for twelve seconds. Hit both and you get an extra ball. Which two you draw makes an enormous difference, so look at the playfield the instant the round starts.

steps.detail: Every ramp shot into the spiral advances it.
Twelve seconds is not enough time to work it out mid-shot.
If one of the two is a low-percentage shot, bank the safe one so the round is not wasted.

goals.title: The Multiball Hurry-Up
goals.summary: Complete the Rapids column and the Pipeline lights for multiball as a hurry-up starting at 5M. The value counts down and the multiball itself is lost if you let it expire, so drop everything and shoot the Pipeline.

steps.detail: You can also reach a lock by finishing the grid's bottom three rows, which lights the Pipeline with no countdown attached.
Let the hurry-up time out and you lose the multiball, not just the points.

goals.title: Multiball And The Super Jackpot
goals.summary: Lock at the Pipeline and multiball starts. Two random slides light — hit both and the Rapids is lit for a 5M jackpot. Collect it and all five light, and clearing those puts the Rapids up for a 30M Super Jackpot. That loop is the fastest scoring on the machine.

steps.action: Lock, then take the skill shot
steps.detail: Locking at the Pipeline and then making the skill shot gives three balls instead of two. Instant Multiball from the Plunge is always two.
They are drawn from the Pipeline, Rapids, Boomerang, Whirlpool and Arcade — never the Souvenirs target or the Splash.

steps.action: Cash the jackpot at the Rapids
steps.detail: Worth 5M, occasionally 9M.

steps.action: Clear all five, then the Super
steps.detail: The Super Jackpot is always 30M, and the five lights come back to relight it. Do this during Double round and it is 60M a time.

goals.title: D-O-U-B-L-E
goals.summary: The most valuable thing on the playfield. Once the Pipeline column is complete, Pipeline shots briefly light Adv. Double for a letter, and the Plunge can award letters too. Complete the word and everything doubles until you lose the ball — scores, extra balls, specials, even grid advances.
goals.reward: Everything doubled for the rest of the ball

steps.detail: The light only stays on briefly after a Pipeline shot, and once you collect it you must hit another target before the Pipeline will relight it.
The Plunge can advance a letter or complete the whole word outright.
Letters cannot be collected during multiball or a timed round, so build the word first and then start something big.

goals.title: Build The Whirlpool
goals.summary: The spiral pays per swirl, and the per-swirl value is something you build. It starts each ball at 50K and climbs 50K for every Whirlpool shot up to 350K — then resets to 50K at the start of the next ball, so it is worth rebuilding early rather than late.

steps.detail: Each shot raises the per-swirl value by 50K to a ceiling of 350K.
The swirl count is the score, and it can add up to just under ten million on a single visit.

steps.action: Spend spare shots on the Arcade
steps.detail: Once the Whirlpool column is complete, further Whirlpool shots advance the Arcade target value instead.

goals.title: Whirlpool Million
goals.summary: Either the Rapids or the Plunge arms it, and it also shows up briefly after every multiball ends. Once armed, every swirl pays a full million with no ceiling whatsoever — keep the ball spinning and the millions keep coming.

steps.action: Take the Rapids straight after multiball
steps.detail: The Rapids lights to arm the Whirlpool Million for a short time once multiball ends.
The millions only pay if the Whirlpool is hit promptly after it is lit.

goals.title: Go For The Record
goals.summary: Once the Rapids column is complete, consecutive Rapids shots are counted. Beat the machine's standing record and you get your initials in and the Special lights on the Rapids. In Double round the counter climbs two at a time, which is the realistic way to take it.
goals.reward: Initials, and a Special at the Rapids

steps.detail: The counter does not run until the Rapids column is finished.
The Rapids returns to the right inlane, which sets up the next one — the shot is designed to be looped.
During Double, every Rapids counts as two toward the record.

goals.title: Feed The Arcade Target
goals.summary: The spring-loaded target in the bottom right is worth far more than the 100K, 200K, 300K printed on it. With the second row lit it climbs 100K a hit to 600K, and with the top row lit it starts at a million and climbs a million per hit.
goals.reward: Up to 600K a hit, or 1M and climbing

steps.detail: The second row lights it at 100K, the top row lights Super Score at 1M.
Once the Whirlpool column is finished, Whirlpool shots push the Arcade value up while it is lit.

steps.action: Cash it before the ball ends
steps.detail: Super Score stays lit to the end of the ball, but nothing carries past it.

goals.title: Working The Plunge
goals.summary: The Plunge saucer is lit any time you are not in multiball or a timed round, and its award table is unusually rich — most of the game's shortcuts live in it. It is worth shooting on sight rather than saving.
goals.reward: Anything from nothing to a completed grid

steps.action: Shoot it whenever it is lit
steps.detail: Awards include 5K to 5M, an extra ball, a special, instant multiball, a lit Souvenirs target, and a catch-up score if you are behind.
It can advance a random slide, push one to the top of its column, or award everything — which completes the grid, but skips you past the bonus rounds you would have earned on the way.
Swirl Whirlpool gives five free swirls and raises the Whirlpool value without advancing its column.

goals.title: Finish The Grid, Then Do It Again
goals.summary: A completed grid is worth 5M on your end-of-ball bonus and starts you on a fresh one. From the second grid onward the Special light is on, and after every odd-numbered grid the Extra Special lights as well — but only if you complete the next grid before losing the ball.

steps.detail: Every completed grid adds 5M to your bonus and the count never resets during a game.

steps.action: Start the next one straight away
steps.detail: Extra Special goes out if you lose the ball before finishing the following grid, so the pressure is real.
Completing a further grid with Extra Special lit awards a second Special on top of the first.

goals.title: The Consolation Rules
goals.summary: This machine looks after players who are struggling. Start your final ball under about 10M and the Souvenirs target is already lit and walked up to Extra Ball, so a single hit takes it. And if you have not had multiball by the last ball, the Plunge will hand you one.
goals.reward: A free extra ball and a free multiball

steps.detail: Normally three hits, but on a low-scoring final ball it is already sitting on Extra Ball.

steps.action: Shoot the Plunge on your last ball
steps.detail: If multiball has not happened yet, instant multiball is waiting there.

goals.title: The Death Save
goals.summary: A left-side drain here is not always final. Bounce the ball off the pin at the mouth of the trough and you can put it back into play — but be aware that pulling one off stops any timed round you had running, with Double round the only exception.

steps.detail: Your bounce target is the pin standing where the ball trough opens.
Any timed round running at the time stops dead. Double round survives it, so a Double is the safest time to try.

achievements.title: Shoot Gently
achievements.desc: Land the soft plunge in the Plunge saucer on your first attempt.

achievements.title: One More For The Splash
achievements.desc: Complete any bonus grid column and start its round.

achievements.title: All The Animals
achievements.desc: Collect the toucan, elephant, monkey and lion during Safari for the Special.

achievements.title: Three Million
achievements.desc: Cash the Three Million target during its nine-second round.

achievements.title: Ride The Pipeline
achievements.desc: Lock at the Pipeline and start multiball.

achievements.title: Thirty Million
achievements.desc: Light and collect a Super Jackpot at the Rapids.

achievements.title: Double Everything
achievements.desc: Complete D-O-U-B-L-E and play a ball with everything doubled.

achievements.title: Million Per Swirl
achievements.desc: Light the Whirlpool Million and cash an uncapped spin.

achievements.title: Go For The Record
achievements.desc: Beat the machine's standing Rapids record and light the Special.

achievements.title: Ride All The Slides
achievements.desc: Complete an entire bonus grid for the 5M bonus.

achievements.title: And Again
achievements.desc: Complete a second grid with Extra Special lit for two Specials at once.

drills.title: Soft Plunge Reps
drills.text: Plunge gently enough to drop the ball straight into the Plunge saucer, and treat every attempt as the only one that counts. Feel out the narrow band between a plunge so weak the ball rolls back to you and one hard enough to vanish into the pop bumpers.

drills.title: Rapids Repeat Loop
drills.text: The Rapids returns the ball to the right inlane, which lines up the next one, so shoot it straight back without cradling in between. Count consecutive makes and treat the streak, not the single shot, as the score.

drills.title: Three-Drop Splash Clears
drills.text: Clear all three centre drop targets in one visit rather than picking at them across a ball. The full clear is what advances the Splash column, and the Splash column is the only thing that starts Safari.

drills.title: Spring-Target Rebounds
drills.text: Hit the Souvenirs and Arcade targets from a settled ball and catch what comes back instead of flipping at it. Both are spring loaded and throw the ball out with real speed, so the shot you have to be ready for is the return.

drills.title: Four-Animal Safari Sweep
drills.text: Once Safari starts, run the Rapids and the Whirlpool ramp first while the ball is still under control, then take the Boomerang and finish on the Arcade lion. Nineteen seconds covers four shots only if none of the first two are wasted.

drills.title: Double Letter Alternation
drills.text: Shoot the Pipeline, collect the letter while the light is still on, then put a shot into any other target before coming back. The Pipeline will not relight Adv. Double until you have hit something else, so back-to-back Pipeline shots waste half the trip.
drills.reps: spell the word once, single ball

actionButton.how: A plain 1991 Gottlieb cabinet: two flippers in the usual places, a manual plunger, and nothing else to press. Your only other input is plunge strength, and it does matter — shoot too softly and the ball rolls straight back to you with the machine telling you so.

howItPlays.objective: Surf 'N Safari is a Gottlieb table that channels nearly everything through one five-by-five light grid above the flippers. Five shots each fill a column to trigger a timed round, five rows each switch on a feature, and finishing whole grids stacks Specials onto your end-of-ball bonus.
loop: Shoot the five column shots -- the Pipeline, the Rapids, the Boomerang, the three Splash drops, and the Whirlpool ramp -- to fill columns; a full column kicks off that column's timed round.
Complete rows across the grid to switch features on: the outlane Exit awards, the Arcade value, the multiball Lock, a Souvenirs extra ball, and Super Score.
Take free column advances by rolling a lit inlane slide; on later grids only one is lit, and slingshot hits swap which one it is.
Lock at the Pipeline to start multiball, then loop the Rapids for five-million jackpots and the thirty-million Super.
Spell DOUBLE at the Pipeline and the Plunge to double everything -- scores, extra balls, Specials -- for the rest of the ball.

lights.name: Grid Columns & Rounds
lights.lit: Five shots each own a column of the grid and a lit cell shows how far that column has filled, and filling a column starts its own timed round on the spot -- Pipeline for Three Million, Boomerang for the boosted spinner, Splash for Safari, Whirlpool for an Extra Ball round, and Rapids to arm multiball.
lights.then: Safari off the Splash column is the best round on the game -- four animals, the Rapids toucan, Boomerang elephant, Whirlpool monkey and Arcade lion, light for nineteen seconds and pay one, two, three million and then a Special. During multiball and every timed round but Double, the columns lock and take no advances at all.

lights.name: Grid Rows & Awards
lights.lit: Each completed row across the grid lights a different feature rather than paying points, so the row you are closest to tells you what to shoot -- bottom lights the outlane Exit awards, second the Arcade target, third the multiball Lock, fourth a Souvenirs extra ball, and the top row Super Score.
lights.then: The Exit awards turn a drain into a random five thousand to five million, while Super Score parks a million on the Arcade target and adds another every hit. Finishing a full grid drops five million into your end-of-ball bonus, plus ten thousand for every lit cell still showing.

lights.name: Advance Slide Rollovers
lights.lit: A lit inlane slide advances a grid column for free when you roll it, and on the first grid both are lit while afterward only one is -- and it does not move when you press a flipper, since slingshot hits or rolling the lit slide itself are what swap it.
lights.then: After each use the slide goes dark until another playfield target is struck, so you cannot milk it by rocking the ball between the lanes. Once the top row is all that remains on the grid, the slide lights switch off completely.

lights.name: The Plunge Saucer
lights.lit: The Plunge saucer glows whenever no multiball or timed round is running, which covers most of a game, and it doubles as the target of the opening soft-plunge skill shot and as the mystery-award hole.
lights.then: Its award table is unusually deep, so shoot it on sight instead of hoarding it -- a few thousand up to five million, a Special or an extra ball, instant multiball, a freshly lit Souvenirs target, DOUBLE letters, a slide advance, or an Award Everything that completes the grid outright. However it pays, the ball loops back through the Rapids and out to the right inlane.

lights.name: DOUBLE Letters
lights.lit: Once the Pipeline column is finished a Pipeline shot briefly lights Adv. Double for one letter, while the Plunge can hand out letters or the whole word at once, so a lit letter is one you have banked toward DOUBLE.
lights.then: The light lingers only a moment after each Pipeline shot, and once collected you must strike some other target before the Pipeline will relight it, so alternate rather than firing the Pipeline back to back. Finish the word and every score doubles until the ball drains, the Super Jackpot among them at sixty million.

lights.name: The Whirlpool
lights.lit: The spiral pays for every swirl the ball makes on its way down and the per-swirl value is one you build, opening each ball at fifty thousand and climbing fifty thousand a Whirlpool shot to three hundred fifty before it falls back next ball.
lights.then: One deep visit can score just under ten million, and better still is Whirlpool Million -- armed by the Rapids or the Plunge and lit for a moment after every multiball -- where each swirl is worth a full million with no cap at all, so keep the ball spinning. Once the Whirlpool column is done, spare ramp shots pump the Arcade value instead.

lights.name: Multiball & Super Jackpot
lights.lit: Filling the Rapids column lights the Pipeline for multiball as a hurry-up opening at five million and counting down -- let it expire and you lose the multiball itself, not just the value -- while finishing the grid's bottom three rows also lights the Lock with no countdown.
lights.then: Lock at the Pipeline to start it, adding the skill shot for three balls rather than two, then hit both lit slides to arm a five-million Rapids jackpot, collect that to light all five, and clear them to raise a thirty-million Super on the Rapids. Because the Rapids feeds the right inlane every time, that loop is the quickest scoring on the machine, and it doubles to sixty million a Super in Double round.

scoring.text: Open with the soft-plunge skill shot into the Plunge saucer -- and if you overcook it into the pops, take an outlane while the Exit lights flash for a quick extra ball. Build the Whirlpool value early and fill a column to start your first round.

Fill columns to trigger their rounds -- Safari off the Splash column is the richest -- and complete rows for the Arcade value and the multiball Lock. Work the deep Plunge award table on sight, and spell DOUBLE when you can bank it safely.

Lock at the Pipeline and loop the Rapids for five-million jackpots and the thirty-million Super Jackpot -- sixty million with Double round running. Whirlpool Million stacks on top at an uncapped million a swirl, and every finished grid keeps feeding Specials and end-of-ball bonus.
